meta.name: Comedy Dynamics
meta.description:
The largest collection of stand-up comedy! It’s a no drink minimum show 24/7, with the top names of comedy in new & classic performances.

Shows: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos, Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy, Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood, Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map, Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Tubi, Plex
